NO_AUTOMATIC_DIRECTION.description: Account the fact but do not infer Gold direction automatically.

SEMANTIC_ADJUDICATION_REQUIRED.description: Unstructured/causal semantic meaning requires a certified adjudication referencing the exact observation.

REAL_YIELD_STOCK_AND_IMPULSE.description: Positive real yield is an opportunity-cost headwind; negative is support. Falling real yield is bullish impulse; rising is bearish impulse. Conflicting stock/impulse => MIXED. No magnitude score.

FED_POLICY_CURVE_IMPULSE.description: Compare structured implied average rate curve with prior observation; lower path bullish Gold, higher path bearish. Do not fabricate meeting probabilities.

USD_INDEX_IMPULSE_NONADDITIVE.description: Rising USD index is bearish transmission; falling is bullish transmission. Non-additive unless a separately identified autonomous USD shock owns the move.

PRICE_RESPONSE_DELTA_ONLY.description: Price sign change is downstream transmission only and cannot change causal root polarity.

POSITIVE_FLOW_DIRECTION.description: Direction requires explicit signed net/change semantics or a declared level delta. A positive gross level (withdrawals, holdings, imports, deliveries, activity) is never bullish merely because it is above zero.

POSITIVE_OFFICIAL_DEMAND.description: Positive net official purchases are bullish structural carry; negative net sales bearish structural carry. Not intraday flow.

SUPPLY_CHANGE_INVERSE.description: Higher physical supply/recycling/hedging supply is bearish supply impulse; lower is bullish. Slow series are horizon-conditioned.

CFTC_POSITIONING_CONTEXT.description: Infer long/short and change in net positioning only. Never treat as live flow or causal direction.

MECHANICAL_SEMANTIC.description: Mechanical force direction requires explicit structure/semantic evidence; it lives only in MECHANICAL_FORCED plane.

EVENT_SHOCK_NONADDITIVE.description: Event shock may activate/reroute roots but never directly votes Gold direction.

STRUCTURAL_PRIOR_ONLY.description: Structural fact informs STRUCTURAL_CARRY and matching root prior; direct session direction authority false.
